name: Twitch Insights
what_it_is: Twitch Insights is a third-party stats site for Twitch with game rankings, account stats, extension stats and lists of Twitch staff and known bots.
pricing: No prices on the homepage; the site connects with a Twitch login and shows its stats openly.
notable: The homepage says its data is updated every 15 minutes
The footer says the site is not affiliated with Twitch and names the creator AlphaDuplo
Copyright line on the homepage reads 2023

facts.fact: Twitch Insights describes itself as a third-party tool that gives insights about Twitch, such as how a game performs and who the Twitch staff are.
The Twitch Insights homepage says its updates are made every 15 minutes.
The Twitch Insights menu lists Game Ranking, Account Stats and Extension Stats, and the homepage shows Most Viewed Games and Most Streamed Games tables.
The Twitch Insights footer says the site is not affiliated with Twitch.tv and carries a 2023 copyright line.
